title: fsl_regfilt
description: Data de-noising by regressing out part of a design matrix using simple OLS regression on 4D images

designfile.description: File name of the matrix with time courses (e.g. GLM design or MELODIC mixing matrix)
designfile.title: Design file

outfile.description: Output file name for the filtered data
outfile.title: Output file

filter.description: Filter out part of the regression model, e.g., -f "1,2,3"
filter.title: Filter

freq_filter_flag.description: Filter out components based on high vs. low frequency content
freq_filter_flag.title: Frequency filter flag

freq_ic_flag.description: Switch off IC Z-stats filtering as part of frequency filtering
freq_ic_flag.title: Frequency IC Z-stats filtering flag

freq_ic_smooth.description: Smoothing width for IC Z-stats filtering as part of frequency filtering
freq_ic_smooth.title: Frequency IC Z-stats smoothing width

aggressive_flag.description: Switch on aggressive filtering (full instead of partial regression)
aggressive_flag.title: Aggressive filtering flag

out_data.description: Output file name for pre-processed data (prior to denoising)
out_data.title: Output pre-processed data

out_mix.description: Output file name for new mixing matrix
out_mix.title: Output new mixing matrix

out_vnscales.description: Output file name for scaling factors from variance normalisation
out_vnscales.title: Output variance normalisation scales
